official_instruction: Turn on the radio receiver that's on the table in the living room.
strategy_provenance: User-requested strategy: use the right hand to pick up the radio, then the left hand to press its power button.

goals.target: the radio specified by the task
goals.done_when: the identified radio follows the right hand through a measured verification lift

goals.target: the power button of the radio held in the right hand
goals.done_when: the radio's power indicator visibly changes to its on state
